00047 class BufferChannelInternal : public SmartPointer
00048 {
00049 public:
00050  BufferChannelInternal(const unsigned int size, bool zeroData = false) throw();
00051  BufferChannelInternal(const unsigned int size, const unsigned int sourceDataSize, const float* sourceData) throw();
00052  BufferChannelInternal(const unsigned int size, const double start, const double end) throw();
00053  ~BufferChannelInternal() throw();
00054  
00055  inline float getSampleUnchecked(const int index) const throw() { return data[index]; }
00056  inline float getSampleUnchecked(const double index) const throw() 
00057  { 
00058   const int iIndex0 = (int)index;
00059   unsigned int iIndex1 = iIndex0+1;
00060   if(iIndex1 >= size_)
00061    iIndex1 = 0;
00062   const float frac1 = (float)index - (float)iIndex0;
00063   const float frac0 = 1.f - frac1;
00064   
00065   return data[iIndex0] * frac0 + data[iIndex1] * frac1; // need to optimise this at some point  
00066  }
00067  
00068  friend class Buffer;
00069  friend class PartBuffer;
00070  friend class ComplexBuffer;
00071  
00072 private:
00073  float* data;
00074  unsigned int size_;
00075  unsigned int allocatedSize;
00076  
00077  BufferChannelInternal (const BufferChannelInternal&);
00078     const BufferChannelInternal& operator= (const BufferChannelInternal&);
00079 };

00290

00310  template<class NumericalType>
00311  inline NumericalArray<NumericalType> toArray(const int channel) const throw()
00312  {
00313   NumericalArray<NumericalType> array;
00314   
00315   if(channels != 0)
00316   {
00317    int channelToUse = channel;
00318    while(channelToUse < 0)
00319     channelToUse += numChannels_;
00320    
00321    NumericalArray<float> floatArray = NumericalArray<float>::withArray(size_, 
00322                     channels[channel % numChannels_]->data, 
00323                     false);
00324    array = floatArray;
00325   }
00326   
00327   return array;
00328  }
